items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And Luke is on that record. Yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh. Oh. Okay.

ctx.x: Okay, well, it was from Chicago. Anyway, they sent us, when we were in the studio waiting for the song, the band was sitting there waiting, the song came by playing. And when it got the song, it rushed on to the studio. I had never heard it. And so the lady took it and she typed the word. And then they gave the song to me. And I went in the booth. And I learned the song. And then I went in the studio and recorded it. And that was, well, what we did, we did an exact copy of that record, whoever that was. And that…
But I'm sure it's on that album.
